<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the prior work of the first three years, the service of the fourth year also becomes characterized by a leap and skip, leading to the revelation of that which is above the chain of descent in the fifth year, connected to the directive of the birthday of Tiferes within Tiferes to begin with a leap.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="2">that through the service of the fourth year</t>
    <t s="3">(which in itself is in order and gradation)</t>
    <t s="4">coming after and through the precedence of the service of the first three years,</t>
    <t s="5">there is brought about a matter of skipping and leaping also in the service of the fourth year.</t>
    <t s="6">For this is also the reason that from the service of the fourth year one comes to the revelation of that which is above the chain of descent in the fifth year.</t>
    <t s="7">And one may connect this with the instruction of the one whose birthday is Tiferes within Tiferes,</t>
    <t s="8">that there must be "from the outset, a leap over."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>May it be His will that through our actions and service, especially in the manner of "from the outset, a leap over," the voice of my Beloved arrives, leaping over mountains and skipping hills, referring to King Moshiach who will come and redeem us.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="1">that through our deeds and our service,</t>
    <t s="2">and particularly in the manner of "from the outset, a leap over,"</t>
    <t s="3">there will be the voice of my Beloved, behold He comes, leaping over the mountains, skipping over the hills,</t>
    <t s="4">according to the explanation of the Midrash</t>
    <t s="5">that it refers to King Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="6">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="7">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through the prior work of the first three years, the service of the fourth year also becomes characterized by a leap and skip, leading to the revelation of that which is above the chain of descent in the fifth year, connected to the directive of the birthday of Tiferes within Tiferes to begin with a leap.

translations.translation: that through the service of the fourth year
(which in itself is in order and gradation)
coming after and through the precedence of the service of the first three years,
there is brought about a matter of skipping and leaping also in the service of the fourth year.
For this is also the reason that from the service of the fourth year one comes to the revelation of that which is above the chain of descent in the fifth year.
And one may connect this with the instruction of the one whose birthday is Tiferes within Tiferes,
that there must be "from the outset, a leap over."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: May it be His will that through our actions and service, especially in the manner of "from the outset, a leap over," the voice of my Beloved arrives, leaping over mountains and skipping hills, referring to King Moshiach who will come and redeem us.

translations.translation: And may it be His will,
that through our deeds and our service,
and particularly in the manner of "from the outset, a leap over,"
there will be the voice of my Beloved, behold He comes, leaping over the mountains, skipping over the hills,
according to the explanation of the Midrash
that it refers to King Moshiach,
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
